Mod.Name: Blank Card Printer
Mod.Author: Local
Mod.Description:
Adds a Card Printer machine that prints vanilla blank keycards. It needs a battery in its power slot; the Print button shows the price before you press it. Find it in toolTable scavenging or buy it from the inventor.
Easy mode (default) keeps the original cost: 3 power and 10 credits per card, no material. Normal mode adds a filament slot and uses 1 unit of 3D Printing Filament per card, plus 6 power and 10 credits - so it stops being a way to print credits into cards. The mode is chosen in the mod settings and applies after a reload.
